overall: Resolved by informal action: the AG found no violation in withholding executive session minutes on a property purchase while the lawful secrecy purpose continued, and the Board later released them after the purpose ended.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the Board should have released executive session minutes on a 3 Kendrick Avenue property purchase in response to public records requests.
allegations.key_passage: Here, we find that the Board did not violate the Open Meeting Law because, at the time of Ms. Ahern’s July 19 public records request and continuing into the spring of 2020, the Board was still considering purchasing property at 3 Kendrick Avenue and therefore the lawful purpose for secrecy remained.
